info.name: CYCLES_RENDERER_SAMPLING_CONTROLS
info.comment: Cycles vendor extension: renderer parameters mapping directly onto Cycles Integrator/Film sockets. All defaults equal the Cycles socket defaults, so leaving them unset changes nothing.

parameters.name: maxBounce
parameters.description: total maximum number of light bounces (Cycles Integrator 'max_bounce'); 0 gives direct lighting only

parameters.name: maxDiffuseBounce
parameters.description: maximum number of diffuse bounces (Cycles Integrator 'max_diffuse_bounce')

parameters.name: maxGlossyBounce
parameters.description: maximum number of glossy bounces (Cycles Integrator 'max_glossy_bounce')

parameters.name: maxTransmissionBounce
parameters.description: maximum number of transmission bounces (Cycles Integrator 'max_transmission_bounce')

parameters.name: maxVolumeBounce
parameters.description: maximum number of volume scattering bounces (Cycles Integrator 'max_volume_bounce')

parameters.name: maxTransparencyBounce
parameters.description: maximum number of transparency bounces (Cycles Integrator 'transparent_max_bounce')

parameters.name: clampDirect
parameters.description: clamp direct-light sample values to this maximum brightness; 0 disables clamping (Cycles Integrator 'sample_clamp_direct')

parameters.name: clampIndirect
parameters.description: clamp indirect-light sample values to this maximum brightness to reduce fireflies at the cost of energy loss; 0 disables clamping (Cycles Integrator 'sample_clamp_indirect')

parameters.name: lightTree
parameters.description: use the light tree for many-light importance sampling (Cycles Integrator 'use_light_tree')

parameters.name: lightSamplingThreshold
parameters.description: probabilistically terminate light samples expected to contribute less than this threshold; 0 disables (Cycles Integrator 'light_sampling_threshold'; only used when 'lightTree' is off)

parameters.name: causticsReflective
parameters.description: render reflective caustics (Cycles Integrator 'caustics_reflective'); disable to reduce fireflies from glossy surfaces

parameters.name: causticsRefractive
parameters.description: render refractive caustics (Cycles Integrator 'caustics_refractive'); disable to reduce fireflies from transmissive surfaces

parameters.name: filterGlossy
parameters.description: blur glossy reflections after blurry bounces by this roughness amount to reduce caustics noise; 0 disables (Cycles Integrator 'filter_glossy')

parameters.name: aoBounces
parameters.description: fast-GI approximation: replace global illumination after this many bounces with ambient occlusion; 0 disables (Cycles Integrator 'ao_bounces')

parameters.name: aoFactor
parameters.description: strength of the fast-GI ambient occlusion (Cycles Integrator 'ao_factor'; only used when 'aoBounces' > 0)

parameters.name: aoDistance
parameters.description: maximum occluder distance considered by the fast-GI ambient occlusion (Cycles Integrator 'ao_distance'; only used when 'aoBounces' > 0)

parameters.name: adaptiveSampling
parameters.description: skip sampling pixels that already converged below 'adaptiveThreshold' while accumulating (Cycles Integrator 'use_adaptive_sampling'); frames still complete normally, converged pixels just stop changing

parameters.name: adaptiveThreshold
parameters.description: noise level at which adaptive sampling considers a pixel converged (Cycles Integrator 'adaptive_threshold')

parameters.name: adaptiveMinSamples
parameters.description: minimum accumulated samples before adaptive sampling may stop a pixel; 0 picks an automatic value (Cycles Integrator 'adaptive_min_samples')

parameters.name: exposure
parameters.description: linear scale applied to rendered radiance before it is written to the frame (Cycles Film 'exposure')

parameters.name: pixelFilter
parameters.description: pixel reconstruction filter used to splat samples into the frame (Cycles Film 'filter_type')

parameters.name: pixelFilterWidth
parameters.description: pixel reconstruction filter width in pixels (Cycles Film 'filter_width'; ignored for the 'box' filter)
